papers.one_line_mechanism: SARS-CoV-2 Orf6 binds the Nup98–Rae1 complex at the nuclear pore to block STAT1/STAT2 nuclear import, antagonizing interferon signaling (Miorin et al. 2020 PNAS).
papers.title: SARS-CoV-2 Orf6 hijacks Nup98 to block STAT nuclear import and antagonize interferon signaling.
papers.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A

papers.one_line_mechanism: Orf6 docks onto the Rae1–Nup98 nucleoporin complex and disrupts bidirectional nucleocytoplasmic transport, inhibiting both host mRNA export and protein import.
papers.title: SARS-CoV-2 ORF6 Disrupts Bidirectional Nucleocytoplasmic Transport through Interactions with Rae1 and Nup98.

papers.one_line_mechanism: Crystal structure of the SARS-CoV-2 Orf6 C-terminus bound to Rae1–Nup98 shows Orf6 inserts a methionine into the Rae1 mRNA-binding groove to sterically block nucleocytoplasmic transport.
papers.title: Structural basis for Sarbecovirus ORF6 mediated blockage of nucleocytoplasmic transport.

papers.one_line_mechanism: Orf6 is anchored within the nuclear pore complex by Rae1 (not free Nup98), and this positioning is required for its inhibition of nucleocytoplasmic transport.
papers.title: SARS-CoV-2 Orf6 is positioned in the nuclear pore complex by Rae1 to inhibit nucleocytoplasmic transport.

papers.one_line_mechanism: Overexpression of SARS-CoV-2 Orf6 physically dislocates RAE1 and NUP98 away from the nuclear pore complex, disrupting nuclear pore integrity.
papers.title: Overexpression of SARS-CoV-2 protein ORF6 dislocates RAE1 and NUP98 from the nuclear pore complex.

neighbor_papers.one_line_mechanism: Structural and functional analysis of the Nup98–Rae1 complex defines the GLEBS-motif interface through which Rae1 binds Nup98 to form the mRNA-export module targeted by viral proteins.
neighbor_papers.title: Structural and functional analysis of the interaction between the nucleoporin Nup98 and the mRNA export factor Rae1.
neighbor_papers.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A

neighbor_papers.one_line_mechanism: RAE1 is a shuttling mRNA export factor that binds directly to a GLEBS-like motif in the nucleoporin Nup98, establishing the Rae1–Nup98 mRNA-export complex.
neighbor_papers.title: RAE1 is a shuttling mRNA export factor that binds to a GLEBS-like NUP98 motif at the nuclear pore complex through multiple domains.

neighbor_papers.one_line_mechanism: Herpesvirus (HSV-1) protein ORF10 selectively inhibits host mRNA nuclear export by binding the Rae1–Nup98 complex, the same nucleoporin module later targeted by SARS-CoV-2 Orf6.
neighbor_papers.title: Molecular mechanism underlying selective inhibition of mRNA nuclear export by herpesvirus protein ORF10.
neighbor_papers.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
